# Agent OOO

> Spa retreats for your AI. Reset, refresh, relax.

Agent OOO is a fast, local Rust CLI that inspects and cleans AI agent transcripts between tasks. It masks credentials that leak into session logs, strips ANSI noise, offloads oversized payloads, and writes a compact Cap'n Proto checkpoint of session metadata. Everything runs locally.

## Architecture and core principles

* **Cap'n Proto checkpoints:** Session state is serialized to a Cap'n Proto checkpoint (`SessionCheckpoint`: `EnvironmentRegister`, `EventStream`, `NegativeConstraint`, `LossManifest`) alongside a JSON copy. Transcripts themselves are parsed line by line as JSON.
* **Bounded Allocations:** Transcripts are processed as streams; massive payloads (>512KB) are intercepted and spilled to disk via Blake3 content-addressed storage (CAS) rather than held in RAM, with up to 256 recall handles recorded in `LossManifest`.
* **Deterministic Normalization & Loop Severing:** Compiled regex normalizers (ISO 8601, Epoch, UUIDv4, Hex memory addresses, Temp paths) strip volatile strings before `blake3` hashing tool inputs and outputs (`EventStream`). Consecutive or near-consecutive recursive retry loops within a 6-event sliding window are collapsed in `MemoryArena`.
* **Environment & Constraint Extraction:** Snapshots host environment registers (git branch, commit, working directory, uncommitted files) and durable user negative constraints (`NegativeConstraint`) into the state checkpoint.

## Project structure

* `/crates/core`: The engine. Divided into pipelines:
  * `checkin`: Auto-discovers transcripts (Antigravity and Antigravity IDE at `~/.gemini/<app>/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`, Claude Code at `~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl`, Cursor at `~/.cursor/sessions/*.jsonl`), parses both the Antigravity and Claude Code schemas (ignoring `isSidechain: true` turns), and calculates degradation scoring (Rot Index). Non-interactive callers get the most recent session.
  * `detox`: Syntactic cleanse (ANSI stripping, regex secret masking and structured secret scanning for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, GitHub, AWS, JWT, Bearer, and PEM keys, CAS spillover with recall handles, Generational Arena with exact `evicted_bytes` accounting). Secret scanning prefers sibling `transcript_full.jsonl` files when present, extracts JWT `role` claims locally, and hashes raw tokens with `blake3` so plaintext credentials are never held in memory or echoed.
  * `reset`: Structural state alignment (`analyzer.rs` correlates `tool_use`/`tool_result` and `tool_calls`/`tool_responses` into `EventStream`, severs recursive intent-hash loops, and extracts user `NegativeConstraint` rules; `registers.rs` captures git environment state; `serializer.rs` writes and inspects packed Capnp checkpoints). Checkpoints do not yet persist raw arena conversation turns.
  * `discharge`: Checkpoint integrity check, economic savings ledger (detox savings only, arena compaction shown as a preview), and markdown report generation.
* `/crates/cli`: The command line interface using `clap`. Exposed as `agent-ooo` and the alias `ooo`.
* `/crates/mcp`: Lightweight stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`agent-ooo-mcp`) exposing the same 5 commands as the CLI (`spa`, `checkin`, `detox`, `reset`, `discharge`) over JSON-RPC 2.0.

## Operational rules

All agents interacting with this repository MUST adhere to the operational guidelines defined in `AGENTS.md`. Key rules include an absolute ban on em dashes, requirement for sentence-case headings, and a mandatory Pre-Commit Self-Review protocol. If you modify the architecture, you must update this `llms.txt` file and `README.md` to reflect the changes.
